vnd.security.rule.text: The security must hold at least {margin} days past the validity of the bid and be confirmed with the issuer by a second person; a bidder with a posted event of bid conduct lodges a multiple. The numbers follow the rule and are not verified.

vnd.security.receive.title: Receive a bid security
vnd.security.receive.note: The amount asked and the factor are kept as of the day of receipt. A person other than the receiver confirms it with the issuer.
vnd.security.confirm.title: Confirm the security with the issuer
vnd.security.confirm.note: Ask the issuer and keep the reference it gives. A security nobody confirmed does not meet what the package asks.
vnd.security.reject.title: Reject the security
vnd.security.reject.note: The issuer does not know this security. The reason is kept and cannot be changed.
vnd.security.propose.title: Propose forfeiture of the security
vnd.security.propose.note: Only for a reason the law names. Another person decides on a decision paper.
vnd.security.withdraw.title: Withdraw the proposal
vnd.security.withdraw.note: The security goes back to confirmed.
vnd.security.decide.title: Decide the proposed forfeiture
vnd.security.decide.note: Forfeiture needs the decision paper and a reason. Refusing returns the security to confirmed. The decider must not be the proposer.
vnd.security.decision.forfeit.name: Forfeit
vnd.security.decision.refuse.name: Refuse the proposal
vnd.security.release.title: Release or record expiry
vnd.security.release.note: Release when the bid lost or the contract was signed; tick expired when the last day passed. This is final.
vnd.security.ledger.title: Ledger of the moves of the security
vnd.security.ledger.error.text: The ledger of this security could not be read.

vnd.subcontract.declare.title: Subcontracting declared in the bid
vnd.subcontract.declare.note: A new declaration replaces the old; the old one stays as what the bid said.
vnd.subcontract.propose.title: Propose a subcontractor
vnd.subcontract.propose.note: A person other than the proposer approves; the assessment and the subcontract gate run again then.
vnd.subcontract.approve.title: Approve the subcontract
vnd.subcontract.approve.note: The assessment runs again against the declaration and the rule.
vnd.subcontract.approve.exception.note: This subcontract passes the named part or is not in the bid: a reason of at least 20 characters is needed, or the rule blocks it.
vnd.subcontract.reject.title: Reject or withdraw the proposal
vnd.subcontract.reject.note: The proposer withdraws, another person rejects; the reason is kept.
vnd.subcontract.terminate.title: Terminate the subcontract
vnd.subcontract.terminate.note: A terminated subcontract takes no more payments. This is final.
vnd.subcontract.payment.title: Record what the prime paid
vnd.subcontract.payment.note: Record the amount, the day and the reference of the transfer. The subcontractor confirms it later through the supplier portal.
